Hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement welcome guests who share powerful healing journeys at Hippocrates Wellness, including recovery from misdiagnosed conditions, Lyme, cancer, and cognitive decline through detox, diet, stem cell therapies, peptides, and lifestyle changes. The episode highlights personal transformations, practical health tips like walking and greens, and the institute’s integrative programs for reversing chronic disease.

Hippocrates Health Institute in West Palm Beach has been transforming lives for decades. Call for your tour today: 561-471-8876, or visit HippocratesHealthInstitute.org.
